purpose: Cyber Awareness entity kinds for SignalTerrain. Educational and defensive only.

kinds.label: Threat
kinds.description: A defensive awareness topic about a harmful capability or condition — not an attack playbook.

kinds.label: Threat Campaign
kinds.description: A named or documented campaign discussed in public sources.

kinds.label: Malware Family
kinds.description: Family-level literacy about malware behavior categories.

kinds.label: Ransomware Family
kinds.description: Ransomware family awareness — impact and defense framing only.

kinds.label: Vulnerability
kinds.description: A software or hardware weakness discussed publicly.

kinds.label: CVE
kinds.description: A Common Vulnerabilities and Exposures identifier record.

kinds.label: KEV Entry
kinds.description: Known Exploited Vulnerability catalog entry (e.g. CISA KEV) when cited.

kinds.label: Vendor Advisory
kinds.description: Vendor or authority advisory summary.

kinds.label: Patch
kinds.description: A published fix or update path — not automatic deployment.

kinds.label: Exploit Technique
kinds.description: High-level technique literacy (e.g. MITRE ATT&CK style). Never step-by-step exploitation.

kinds.label: Affected Software
kinds.description: A product or library affected by a vulnerability.

kinds.label: Affected Hardware
kinds.description: Hardware platform context when relevant.

kinds.label: Threat Actor
kinds.description: Descriptive public attribution literacy only — never operational targeting aids.

kinds.label: Mitigation
kinds.description: Defensive guidance that reduces exposure or impact.

kinds.label: Indicator
kinds.description: High-level indicator categories only — not raw IOC dumps for offense.

kinds.label: Reference
kinds.description: Citation to a public source.

kinds.label: Timeline Event
kinds.description: A dated milestone in a topic's history.

kinds.label: Source
kinds.description: A publisher or origin of intelligence.

kinds.label: Confidence
kinds.description: Shared confidence vocabulary alignment (usually a field, occasionally a catalog entry).

kinds.label: Region
kinds.description: Geographic scope for awareness.

kinds.label: Industry
kinds.description: Sector relevance for prioritization.

kinds.label: Severity
kinds.description: Attention urgency vocabulary — not CVSS theater alone.
